stills.title: A whole organisation at a glance
stills.alt: gcportrait drawing the whole synthetic demo organisation S in the Overview lens: folders and projects as nested zones, the Shared VPC host's network and subnetworks as tinted zones, resources as cards with Google Cloud product icons, orthogonal arrows for the references between them, a title block and a legend.

stills.title: The Networking lens
stills.alt: The demo organisation M in the Networking lens: Shared VPC host projects with their VPC networks and subnetworks as tinted zones, firewall policies, routers and the projects that attach to them.

stills.title: The selection trace of a load balancer
stills.alt: A global forwarding rule selected in the Load balancing lens: its chain through the target HTTPS proxy, the URL map and the backend services to the instance groups and the serverless network endpoint group is highlighted, with its path to the root of the organisation and its details drawer open.

stills.title: The details drawer
stills.alt: A virtual machine selected in the Compute lens with the details drawer open: its facts, its relations by kind with links, and its Cloud Console page.

stills.title: A day of the timeline compared with the day before
stills.alt: The timeline moved to 24 September: the newly added virtual machines are outlined in green, a deleted one stands as a faded, dashed ghost where it was, and the changed instance group manager carries an amber dot.

stills.title: The Export menu
stills.alt: The Export menu open over the demo organisation S: SVG or PNG at 2× or 3×, the whole diagram or the current viewport, and copying the PNG.

stills.title: The Snapshots page
stills.alt: The Snapshots page listing the demo snapshots stored in this browser, with import, export and delete actions; nothing is uploaded anywhere.

scenes.title: Hover, click, trace
scenes.alt: Animation: the pointer hovers a virtual machine and its path to the root lights up; a click keeps it selected, traces its network and disk connections, and shows the Open in Cloud Console action.

scenes.title: Switching lenses
scenes.alt: Animation: the Lens picker switches the demo organisation S from the Overview to the Networking lens and then to the Load balancing lens; each redraws the same organisation for a different question.

scenes.title: Drill in and expand
scenes.alt: Animation: a click on a collapsed project expands it in place, then a double-click on another project drills into it so that it fills the canvas, with the breadcrumb leading back out.

scenes.title: Stepping through the timeline
scenes.alt: Animation: the Workloads folder of the demo organisation S on the timeline, which jumps from 4 September to 8, 14 and 25 September; each day is drawn compared with the one before. On 8 September a new Pub/Sub subscription is outlined in green, on 14 September the next one is outlined and the first stands as a faded, dashed ghost, and on 25 September the decommissioned reporting project with its bucket, network, subnetwork and virtual machine stands as a ghost, a second machine in the web group is outlined, two more removed resources are ghosts and amber dots mark the changed ones. The view then zooms in on the ghost of the reporting project, marked removed, and moves to the legend, whose rows read added, removed and changed since 14 September.

scenes.title: Search by IP address
scenes.alt: Animation: pressing slash opens the search box, typing the IP address 10.0.14.5 lists the matching resource, and Enter jumps to it on the diagram and opens its details.
